basis: Classified as an inborn error of metabolism; no supplied phenotype evidence supports additional organs.
Inherited cataract affects the lens; additional organ abnormalities are subtype-specific.
Developmental delay in 24/24 and seizures in 15/24 establish neurologic disease; dermatitis and infections are uncommon.
The defining abnormalities affect the eye, cerebral tissue and urinary collecting system.
Congenital fistula of the labial commissure lined by oral mucosa; susceptibility to infection is only a risk.
Organ-specific hereditary colorectal cancer susceptibility; the record establishes predisposition rather than existing cancer or additional organ damage.
Thymic epithelial tumour has no matching axis; it is not lymphoma. Associated myasthenia, red cell aplasia and immunodeficiency are separate diseases.
Adenoma originates in intrahepatic bile ducts; the definition does not support an endocrine origin.
Hereditary abnormalities of epidermal appendages; additional organs are not established across this umbrella.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability are common defining manifestations; other structural abnormalities vary with the deletion.
Malignant squamous epithelial tumour arising in the colon or rectum.
Vulvar neoplasm is classified by its reproductive organ origin; this umbrella does not establish disease of another axis.
Inherited peripheral neuropathy; persistent distal muscle atrophy in 7/7 and characteristic foot deformities support musculoskeletal involvement.
Recurrent episodes of stupor define this neurologic disorder; metabolic and toxic causes are explicitly excluded.
Nonsyndromic progressive hearing impairment in 19/19; no other organ involvement established.
Primary skeletal muscle dystrophy with progressive weakness and atrophy; definition explicitly reports no cardiac or respiratory involvement.
Metabolic hyperammonemia with defining recurrent brain dysfunction; hepatic steatosis in 80-99% and biochemical liver dysfunction in 30-79%.
Glycosylation defect with defining enteropathy and brain disease; thrombocytopenia 3/3, anemia 2/2 and coagulopathy. Renal, hepatic and ocular involvement omitted by cap.
Cerebral enlargement and dysmyelination with seizures, ataxia and spasticity define a brain disorder.
Sensorineural hearing loss and hair pigmentation abnormalities in 36/36; iris heterochromia does not establish ocular damage.
Ulceration directly damages the anal and rectal mucosa; no specific infectious or immune mechanism established.
Usually bacterial infection of mastoid air-cell mucosa in the ear system; destructive bone involvement is not established for every form.
Dermal mucin deposition defines the disease; systemic involvement is inconsistent across subtypes, and monoclonal gammopathy is a separate condition.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with abnormal sperm morphology and motility; no endocrine dysfunction established.
Progressive corneal endothelial disease with iris atrophy, synechiae and visual impairment; manifestations remain within the ocular axis.
